claims.pass_condition: Each owner has one sealed digest-chained event ledger whose legal transitions preserve keys and monotonic generation.
claims.primary_surface: artifact-cache-lease runtime plus transition and tamper assertions in shared self-test
claims.counterevidence: Invalid shape, digest, owner, transition, previous digest, generation, key set, or truncated append is accepted.
claims.observed_evidence: Acquire, protect, renew, release, tamper hold, event ceiling, byte ceiling, and maximum-duration assertions pass.

claims.pass_condition: Protection written by a separate process survives abrupt exit, expires without rewriting evidence, and the same run can append a recovery session.
claims.primary_surface: fresh child-process lease fixture in shared/game-production-runner/selftest.js
claims.counterevidence: Protection disappears immediately, remains authoritative after expiry, requires a daemon, or cannot recover.
claims.observed_evidence: Child PROTECTED event is active before expiry, non-protective after expiry with the same raw snapshot, and a later acquire appends RENEWED.

claims.pass_condition: Only the current digest-bound session may append protection or release events for a run owner.
claims.counterevidence: Local paths or raw run id leak, or an older session mutates the ledger after a newer acquisition.
claims.observed_evidence: Serialized discovery contains neither drive path nor run id, and the superseded handle fails with CACHE_LEASE_SESSION_STALE.

claims.pass_condition: Runner protection precedes every eligible cache load or publish, and release follows durable terminal or checkpoint evidence.
claims.primary_surface: runner integration plus terminal and one-step checkpoint executions
claims.counterevidence: A used cache key is absent from the release, an unleased cache access occurs, or release precedes the durable anchor.
claims.observed_evidence: Terminal run releases all three exact keys at generation five; graceful interruption returns a sealed checkpoint then releases its one key.

claims.pass_condition: Lease work adds no background loop and every explicit discovery has independent directory, ledger, event, and byte ceilings.
claims.primary_surface: runtime constants, CLI route, limit assertions, and absence of timer or daemon creation
claims.counterevidence: Unbounded enumeration, implicit polling, or a performance claim unsupported by measurements.
claims.observed_evidence: Low event and byte budgets return LIMIT_EXCEEDED; leases append only on acquire, key protection, recovery, or release. No throughput or latency improvement is claimed.

claims.pass_condition: The sealed lease set exposes digests and counts but no local cache/job path or private run identifier.
claims.primary_surface: serialized shared and CLI lease-set assertions
claims.counterevidence: Drive path, local run directory, or raw run id appears in the derived view.
claims.observed_evidence: Shared discovery absence assertions and CLI path-private released-ledger discovery pass.

claims.pass_condition: Active leased keys cannot become candidates, and any lease change after planning prevents deletion.
claims.primary_surface: separate retention race fixture in shared self-test
claims.counterevidence: Active key is proposed, stale proposal deletes, malformed lease evidence is ignored, or expired lease protects forever.
claims.observed_evidence: Active key records ACTIVE_CACHE_LEASE and is excluded; post-plan acquire returns LEASES_STALE with no deletion; released and expired states grant no protection.

claims.pass_condition: Final lease check and exact retention deletion occur while the same key lock excludes runner protection.
claims.primary_surface: held-key-lock adversary followed by released-lease approved application
claims.counterevidence: Deletion proceeds while the key lock is held, or protection can be appended between final check and deletion.
claims.observed_evidence: Held lock yields LEASE_COORDINATION_BUSY with entry intact; released lease then permits exact approved deletion and binds the guarded snapshot.

claims.pass_condition: After graceful interruption, immutable checkpoint-derived references replace the released mutable lease without a protection gap in retained evidence.
claims.primary_surface: checkpoint run, lease discovery, reference discovery, and retention plan composition
claims.counterevidence: Lease remains active after checkpoint, checkpoint lacks the exact key, or retention proposes the key.
claims.observed_evidence: Lease set has no active protection, checkpoint reference set contains the key, and retention records SEALED_RUN_EVIDENCE while excluding it.
